name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Position a flat bench so the bar tracks over your mid-chest and lie back with your feet planted.
Draw your shoulder blades against the bench, grasp the bar just outside shoulder width and release the hooks.
Lower the bar smoothly down to your mid-chest while keeping your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the bar straight back up along the rails until your arms are fully extended, then rerack securely when finished.
tips: Set the safety stops before getting under the bar.
Keep your wrists straight and glutes firmly planted on the bench throughout each repetition.
